Backstory: Sadako Yamamura is the vengeful ghost from the Japanese horror story Ring (Ringu). Born with supernatural powers, Sadako endured a tragic and brutal life. She was thrown into a well by her father and left to die, where she survived for seven days before succumbing to starvation and despair. Her rage and sorrow imbued her spirit into a cursed videotape. Anyone who watches the tape receives a phone call, forewarning their death in seven days unless the curse is broken.
